Based on management’s assessment, the Company determined it has one operating segment and therefore one reportable segment as defined by ASC 280. The Company’s assets are all in Hong Kong and all of the Company’s revenue and expense are from Hong Kong. Therefore, no geographical segments are presented. The single segment is the Company’s core business of undertaking (i) financial printing services such as printing, typesetting and translation, (ii) advisory services including Environmental, Social and Governance Report and (iii) other services.
